prompt: Architectural photograph of a building facade surface, front elevation, clear windows and doors, realistic plaster, masonry and glass, natural diffuse light.
negative_prompt: perspective, tilted, warped windows, extra openings, roof added, cars, street, text, watermark, blurry, drawing, cartoon
style_supervision: CMP is unlabelled for the four UI styles. Style prompts use the frozen pretrained prior, not four learned facade classes.
validation_selection: CMP fixed stratified 12 plus IRF fixed stratified 4; test untouched
